description: This file defines the UserPrincipal class, which implements Spring Security's UserDetails interface to represent a user's authentication and authorization information within the application.

classes.name: UserPrincipal
classes.description: Represents the authenticated user details, including authorities based on user groups.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the collection of granted authorities based on user groups, normalized to ROLE_ prefix.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates the user account is not expired (always true here).

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates the user account is not locked (always true here).

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates the user's credentials are not expired (always true here).

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates the user is enabled (always true here).
